title: commitcoach commit payload
description: The changes of one commit, for the backend that generates learning questions. Produced by `commitcoach export` and by the post-commit hook. Files that look like they hold secrets and binary files are left out of both files and diff. A commit beyond the size limits produces no document at all.

repository_id.description: UUID of the repository registered in the backend (lowercase). Set with `commitcoach init --repository-id` or `export --repository-id`. Unrelated to Git object names and directory names.

commit_sha.description: Full object name of the commit (40 hexadecimal characters in SHA-1 repositories, 64 in SHA-256 ones).

branch.description: Branch checked out when the document was made, which is not necessarily a branch containing the commit (for example when an older commit is exported). null when HEAD is detached.

message.description: Full commit message, unmodified (all lines, usually ending with a newline).

files.description: Repository-relative paths of the files in diff, in the same order (Git's path order): the new path for added, modified and renamed files, the old path for deleted files. [] when there are none.

diff.description: Unified diff of the files in files, as printed by git diff-tree, against the first parent (the empty tree for a root commit; the first parent for a merge commit). Empty when there are no such files.
